News: follow the product-specific help rule. Pro/One/Three/Direct restrict execution in the five minutes before and after relevant high-impact news; Swing requires trades opened in its two-minute window to last longer than two minutes.

EAs: pre-approved risk management/trade assistance on MT5 only; fully automated execution prohibited. Direct EAs disabled. Copy trading requires own-account verification and is unavailable on cTrader, DXtrade and TradeLocker.

No product-specific maximum trading-day value was verified in this recapture. Null is not an unlimited-period or permission claim.

The live selector showed One 6% and 12% choices, whereas the September 21 pricing article says they are unavailable for new purchases. This record covers only the explicitly selected 10% variant. A source-conflict watch records the other variants; no availability conclusion is inferred.

The live One 10% checkout showed On Demand and a disabled Bi-Weekly control. The 6% trailing limit follows maximum account balance and locks at the initial balance after 6% growth; it does not trail equity forever.
